brief.headline: Supplier is a pure trader in distress (D-rated, -199.2% margin, 220.44x leverage, Altman Z -0.18) — lead with supply qualification and a second source, not a hard price squeeze.

priceAsk.summary: Benchmark to a direct manufacturer's price, because they are 100% trader and carry a reseller margin
priceAsk.target: Target price tied to HDPE resin import unit value of 87.61 ₹/kg plus a transparent conversion margin
priceAsk.basis: Their revenue mix is 100.0% traded / 0.0% manufactured, so our price includes a middleman markup; we should pay maker economics

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer 15-day payment (freeing ₹2.60 L working capital for us) in exchange for a 2.77% price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.60 L working capital freed if we move to 15-day terms; their borrowing cost is 2.77%, so early payment is worth that rate to them

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex is deeply distressed: net margin -199.2% vs peer median 2.3%, debt-to-equity 220.44x, Altman Z score -0.18 (distress zone), Probe42 score 1/10, and FY2023-24 PAT ₹-22.50 Cr. They stretch payables to 226d vs peer 41d and run a 335d cash cycle vs peer 70d, so they need cash badly. We represent 5.60% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue (our ₹63.21 L spend), which is meaningful volume — but pushing too hard risks tipping a supplier already in the red. Lead with supply-security questions and qualify a robust alternate (Mold-Tek, Manjushree) before negotiating price; then offer faster payment for a discount rather than a unilateral cut.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, B-rated (65/100), pharma bottles & caps specialist — top alternate candidate

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed, ₹701.17 Cr revenue, C-rated (57/100), moulded & blow-moulded packaging capability for bottles/caps

risks: Supplier is in distress zone (Altman Z -0.18, D health score 0/100, Probe score 1/10) — a hard price cut could trigger supply failure; keep a second source warm
They are 100% trader, so switching to a direct manufacturer may provoke them to walk away; have Mold-Tek or Manjushree qualified before the meeting
Our ₹63.21 L is 5.60% of their revenue, so losing us hurts them — but their -199.2% margin means they may already be below cost; verify supply continuity first
Cash cycle of 335d vs peer 70d and negative free cash flow ₹-164.97 Cr signal liquidity stress — offer faster payment as a carrot, not just a stick on price
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but as you know we're seeing HDPE resin at 87.61 ₹/kg landed and you're a trading house — help us understand the conversion and margin stack so we can align on a maker-equivalent price, and in return we can discuss faster payment to ease your 335-day cash cycle.
